---
title: "Performance of the methods"
format: html
editor: visual
---

One reporting file for all four branches (anchored/unanchored × continuous/time-to-event). Only the **settings** chunk changes between branches. Every figure is drawn for the reference scenario in the document and saved for all scenarios and effect sizes in `out_dir`, so that main and supplementary figures can be chosen afterwards.

Performance measures and Monte Carlo standard errors (MCSE) follow Morris, White and Crowther (2019), Table 6. For the risk ratio, bias, coverage and rejection are computed on the log scale, using the bootstrap SE of log(RR) (`se_log`).

# Libraries

```{r}
pacman::p_load(dplyr,tidyr,ggplot2,readr)
```

# Settings

```{r}
# root of the project folder
base="C:\\Users\\P095206\\OneDrive - Amsterdam UMC\\Shared material with Elia\\PhD\\Project 5 - Simulation study in SATs\\"
# label used in titles and file names
branch="Unanchored, continuous"
# results files, one per effect size, named by the effect size as it should appear in the figures
results_files=c("0.15"=paste0(base,"Data\\paper\\main_analysis\\with duration\\continuous\\results_diff_0.15.rds"))
# true value of the estimand for each file (same names as above)
truths=c("0.15"=0.15)
# "difference" for the continuous outcome, "ratio" for the risk ratio
scale="difference"
# effect size and sample sizes of the reference scenario shown in this document
ref_effect="0.15"; ref_ntrt=30; ref_nctrl=100
# folder where all figures and the table of performance measures are saved
out_dir=paste0(base,"Results\\paper\\main_analysis\\with duration\\continuous\\")
dir.create(out_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
# optional: performance tables (CSV) saved by this file for other branches, to compare branches side by side
# e.g. compare_files=c("Anchored"=paste0(...,"performance_Anchored_time_to_event.csv"),"Unanchored"=...)
compare_files=c()
# helpers for titles and file names
scenario_label=function(ntrt,nctrl) paste0(ntrt," treated, ",nctrl," controls")
file_tag=function(...) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9.]+","_",paste(branch,...,sep="_"))
```

Examples for the other branches:

-   anchored continuous: `results_files=c("0.15"=paste0(base,"Data\\paper\\main_analysis\\without duration\\continuous\\results_diff_0.15.rds"))`, `scale="difference"`
-   time-to-event: `results_files=c("1"=..._rr_1...rds, "0.75"=..., "0.5"=..., "0.25"=...)`, `truths=c("1"=1,"0.75"=0.75,"0.5"=0.5,"0.25"=0.25)`, `scale="ratio"`, `ref_effect="0.5"`
-   comparison of branches: run this file once per branch, then list the saved `performance_*.csv` files in `compare_files`

# Load results

```{r}
results=bind_rows(lapply(names(results_files),function(k){
  readRDS(results_files[[k]]) %>% mutate(effect=k,truth=unname(truths[k]))
})) %>%
  mutate(effect=factor(effect,levels=names(results_files)),
         ratio=ifelse(is.na(ratio),"none",paste0("1:",ratio)),
         result=ifelse(is.finite(result),result,NA_real_))
# analysis scale: difference as is, risk ratio on the log scale
if (scale=="ratio"){
  if (!"se_log" %in% names(results)){
    # older results without se_log: delta-method approximation
    warning("se_log not found, using se/result (delta method)")
    results$se_log=results$se/results$result
  }
  results=results %>% mutate(est=log(result),theta=log(truth),se_est=se_log,null=0)
} else {
  results=results %>% mutate(est=result,theta=truth,se_est=se,null=0)
}
# columns that only exist in some branches (survival: events and Cox model class; regression: ESS)
for (v in c("class","ntrt_event_post","nctrl_event_post","event_before","ess","ntrt_post",
            "smdageb","smdagea","smdsexb","smdsexa","message","se")){
  if (!v %in% names(results)) results[[v]]=NA
}
# rows per method and scenario
results %>% count(effect,method,ratio,ntrt,nctrl) %>% summarise(min_reps=min(n),max_reps=max(n))
```

# Simulated data

Description of the samples drawn in each scenario, before any matching or weighting: one row per repetition (the SMDs and events before matching are the same for every method).

```{r}
simulated=results %>%
  distinct(effect,ntrt,nctrl,sim,.keep_all=TRUE) %>%
  group_by(effect,truth,ntrt,nctrl) %>%
  summarise(repetitions=n(),
            smd_age=mean(abs(smdageb),na.rm=TRUE),
            smd_sex=mean(abs(smdsexb),na.rm=TRUE),
            events_in_sample=mean(as.numeric(event_before),na.rm=TRUE),
            .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(events_in_sample=ifelse(is.nan(events_in_sample),NA_real_,events_in_sample))
simulated
write_csv(simulated,paste0(out_dir,"simulated_data_",gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+","_",branch),".csv"))
```

# Methods

Each method is described by its components, so that figures can group by family, algorithm and caliper, with the ratio as colour.

```{r}
describe=function(m){
  tibble(method=m) %>% mutate(
    family=case_when(m=="raw"~"Unadjusted",
                     m=="duration_matching"~"Duration only",
                     m=="gcomp"~"G-computation",
                     grepl("^iptw",m)~"IPTW",
                     grepl("^exact",m)~"Exact matching",
                     grepl("^psm_p",m)~"PSM, propensity score",
                     grepl("^psm_m",m)~"PSM, Mahalanobis",
                     TRUE~m),
    algorithm=case_when(grepl("optimal",m)~"optimal",grepl("greedy",m)~"greedy",TRUE~""),
    caliper=case_when(grepl("caliper_005",m)~"caliper 0.05",grepl("caliper_01",m)~"caliper 0.1",
                      grepl("noc",m)~"no caliper",TRUE~""),
    label=case_when(m=="iptw, unstabilised"~"unstabilised",
                    m=="iptw, stabilised"~"stabilised",
                    m=="iptw, stabilised, truncated 0.01"~"stabilised, truncated 1%",
                    m=="iptw, stabilised, truncated 0.1"~"stabilised, truncated 10%",
                    algorithm!="" & caliper!=""~paste0(algorithm,", ",caliper),
                    algorithm!=""~algorithm,
                    TRUE~family))
}
family_levels=c("Unadjusted","Duration only","G-computation","IPTW","Exact matching",
                "PSM, propensity score","PSM, Mahalanobis")
label_levels=c("Unadjusted","Duration only","G-computation",
               "unstabilised","stabilised","stabilised, truncated 1%","stabilised, truncated 10%",
               "greedy","optimal","greedy, no caliper","greedy, caliper 0.1","greedy, caliper 0.05")
methods=describe(unique(results$method)) %>%
  mutate(family=factor(family,levels=intersect(family_levels,family)),
         label=factor(label,levels=rev(intersect(label_levels,label))))
methods
```

# Performance measures

All measures use the repetitions in which the method produced an estimate; failures and warnings are reported separately and are not removed.

```{r}
z=qnorm(0.975)
metrics=results %>%
  group_by(effect,truth,method,ratio,ntrt,nctrl) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sim=n(),
    n_ok=sum(!is.na(est)),
    fail=mean(is.na(est)),
    # partial: an estimate was produced, but not all treated were kept
    partial=ifelse(all(is.na(ntrt_post)),NA_real_,mean(!is.na(est) & ntrt_post<ntrt,na.rm=TRUE)),
    # survival: share of fits that needed the ridge-penalised Cox model, and events after matching
    ridge=ifelse(all(is.na(class)),NA_real_,mean(class[!is.na(est)]=="coxph.penal",na.rm=TRUE)),
    events_trt=mean(ntrt_event_post[!is.na(est)],na.rm=TRUE),
    events_ctrl=mean(nctrl_event_post[!is.na(est)],na.rm=TRUE),
    zero_events_trt=mean(ntrt_event_post[!is.na(est)]==0,na.rm=TRUE),
    events_sample=mean(as.numeric(event_before),na.rm=TRUE),
    warn=mean(!is.na(est) & !is.na(message) & message!=""),
    # bias (analysis scale; log scale for the risk ratio)
    bias=mean(est-theta,na.rm=TRUE),
    mcse_bias=sd(est,na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n_ok),
    # median bias and median estimate on the natural scale (robust to a few extreme estimates)
    medbias=median(est-theta,na.rm=TRUE),
    median_estimate=median(result,na.rm=TRUE),
    # relative bias of the estimate on its natural scale (%)
    relbias=ifelse(abs(first(truth))>0,100*(mean(result,na.rm=TRUE)/first(truth)-1),NA_real_),
    # empirical SE
    empse=sd(est,na.rm=TRUE),
    mcse_empse=empse/sqrt(2*(n_ok-1)),
    # mean squared error and its root
    mse=mean((est-theta)^2,na.rm=TRUE),
    mcse_mse=sqrt(sum(((est-theta)^2-mse)^2,na.rm=TRUE)/(n_ok*(n_ok-1))),
    # model-based (bootstrap) SE
    n_se=sum(!is.na(est) & !is.na(se_est)),
    modse=sqrt(mean(se_est^2,na.rm=TRUE)),
    mcse_modse=sqrt(var(se_est^2,na.rm=TRUE)/(4*n_se*modse^2)),
    # coverage and rejection of the null (CI excludes 0 on the analysis scale)
    cover=mean(abs(est-theta)<=z*se_est,na.rm=TRUE),
    reject=mean(abs(est-null)>z*se_est,na.rm=TRUE),
    # matching and weighting diagnostics
    kept=mean(ntrt_post/ntrt,na.rm=TRUE),
    smd_age_before=mean(abs(smdageb),na.rm=TRUE),
    smd_age_after=mean(abs(smdagea),na.rm=TRUE),
    smd_sex_before=mean(abs(smdsexb),na.rm=TRUE),
    smd_sex_after=mean(abs(smdsexa),na.rm=TRUE),
    ess=mean(ess,na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(rmse=sqrt(mse),
         mcse_rmse=mcse_mse/(2*rmse),
         se_ratio=modse/empse,
         relerr_se=100*(se_ratio-1),
         mcse_relerr_se=100*se_ratio*sqrt(mcse_modse^2/modse^2+mcse_empse^2/empse^2),
         mcse_cover=sqrt(cover*(1-cover)/n_se),
         mcse_reject=sqrt(reject*(1-reject)/n_se),
         across(c(ess,events_trt,events_ctrl,zero_events_trt,events_sample),~ifelse(is.nan(.x),NA_real_,.x))) %>%
  left_join(methods,by="method")
# save the full table for the paper and the supplement
write_csv(metrics %>% select(-family,-algorithm,-caliper,-label),
          paste0(out_dir,"performance_",gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+","_",branch),".csv"))
```

# Table of results for the reference scenario

Estimate (Monte Carlo SE) for the main measures; the same values for every scenario are in the saved `performance_*.csv`.

```{r}
fmt=function(x,mc,d=3) ifelse(is.na(x),"",ifelse(is.na(mc),sprintf(paste0("%.",d,"f"),x),
                                                   sprintf(paste0("%.",d,"f (%.",d,"f)"),x,mc)))
make_table=function(eff,nt,nc){
  metrics %>% filter(effect==eff,ntrt==nt,nctrl==nc) %>%
    arrange(family,desc(label),ratio) %>%
    transmute(Family=family,Method=label,Ratio=ratio,
              Bias=fmt(bias,mcse_bias),`Median bias`=fmt(medbias,NA),
              `Empirical SE`=fmt(empse,mcse_empse),`Bootstrap SE`=fmt(modse,mcse_modse),
              RMSE=fmt(rmse,mcse_rmse),Coverage=fmt(cover,mcse_cover),`Rejection rate`=fmt(reject,mcse_reject),
              `Treated kept`=fmt(kept,NA,2),Failed=fmt(fail,NA,2))
}
tab=make_table(ref_effect,ref_ntrt,ref_nctrl)
knitr::kable(tab)
```

```{r}
for (eff in levels(metrics$effect)){
  scen=metrics %>% filter(effect==eff) %>% distinct(ntrt,nctrl)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(scen))){
    write_csv(make_table(eff,scen$ntrt[i],scen$nctrl[i]),
              paste0(out_dir,file_tag("table",eff,scen$ntrt[i],scen$nctrl[i]),".csv"))
  }
}
```

# Figures

## Settings shared by all figures

```{r}
ratio_colours=c("1:1"="#1b9e77","1:2"="#d95f02","1:3"="#7570b3","none"="black")
pd=position_dodge(width=0.6)
theme_report=theme_bw(base_size=10)+
  theme(strip.placement="outside",
        strip.text.y.left=element_text(angle=0,face="bold"),
        strip.background=element_rect(fill="white"),
        legend.position="bottom",
        panel.spacing.x=unit(0.8,"lines"))
scale_lab=ifelse(scale=="ratio"," (log RR)","")
measure_info=tibble(
  measure=c("bias","empse","modse","rmse","cover","reject","kept"),
  mcse=c("mcse_bias","mcse_empse","mcse_modse","mcse_rmse","mcse_cover","mcse_reject",NA),
  name=c(paste0("Bias",scale_lab),paste0("Empirical SE",scale_lab),paste0("Bootstrap SE",scale_lab),
         paste0("RMSE",scale_lab),"Coverage","Rejection rate","Treated kept"),
  reference=c(0,NA,NA,NA,0.95,NA,1))
```

## Figure A: all measures for one scenario

Rows are the methods grouped by family, colours the matching ratio, bars the 95% Monte Carlo intervals. Comparisons by ratio (colours), caliper and algorithm (neighbouring rows) and distance (stacked blocks) are all visible at once.

```{r}
plot_profile=function(eff,nt,nc){
  d=metrics %>% filter(effect==eff,ntrt==nt,nctrl==nc)
  long=bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(measure_info)),function(i){
    mi=measure_info[i,]
    d %>% transmute(family,label,ratio,measure=mi$name,
                    est=.data[[mi$measure]],
                    mc=if (is.na(mi$mcse)) 0 else .data[[mi$mcse]])
  })) %>%
    mutate(measure=factor(measure,levels=measure_info$name))
  refl=measure_info %>% filter(!is.na(reference)) %>%
    transmute(measure=factor(name,levels=measure_info$name),x=reference)
  # the rejection rate is the type I error when the true effect is null
  if (unique(d$truth)==ifelse(scale=="ratio",1,0)) refl=bind_rows(refl,tibble(measure=factor(measure_info$name[6],levels=measure_info$name),x=0.05))
  ggplot(long,aes(x=est,y=label,colour=ratio))+
    geom_vline(data=refl,aes(xintercept=x),linetype=2,colour="grey50")+
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin=est-1.96*mc,xmax=est+1.96*mc),height=0,position=pd)+
    geom_point(position=pd,size=1.8)+
    facet_grid(family~measure,scales="free",space="free_y",switch="y")+
    scale_colour_manual(values=ratio_colours)+
    labs(x=NULL,y=NULL,colour="Ratio",
         title=paste0(branch,": ",scenario_label(nt,nc),", true effect ",eff),
         subtitle=paste0("Points: estimate; bars: 95% Monte Carlo interval (",min(d$n_sim)," repetitions)"))+
    theme_report
}
plot_profile(ref_effect,ref_ntrt,ref_nctrl)
```

```{r}
# save for every effect size and sample-size scenario (supplement)
for (eff in levels(metrics$effect)){
  scen=metrics %>% filter(effect==eff) %>% distinct(ntrt,nctrl)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(scen))){
    ggsave(paste0(out_dir,file_tag("A_profile",eff,scen$ntrt[i],scen$nctrl[i]),".png"),
           plot_profile(eff,scen$ntrt[i],scen$nctrl[i]),width=15,height=7,dpi=300)
  }
}
```

## Figure B: one measure across all sample-size scenarios

```{r}
plot_measure=function(meas,eff){
  mi=measure_info %>% filter(measure==meas)
  d=metrics %>% filter(effect==eff) %>%
    mutate(est=.data[[meas]],mc=if (is.na(mi$mcse)) 0 else .data[[mi$mcse]],
           trt=factor(paste0(ntrt," treated"),levels=paste0(sort(unique(ntrt))," treated")),
           ctrl=factor(paste0(nctrl," controls"),levels=paste0(sort(unique(nctrl))," controls")))
  g=ggplot(d,aes(x=est,y=label,colour=ratio))
  if (!is.na(mi$reference)) g=g+geom_vline(xintercept=mi$reference,linetype=2,colour="grey50")
  g+geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin=est-1.96*mc,xmax=est+1.96*mc),height=0,position=pd)+
    geom_point(position=pd,size=1.5)+
    facet_grid(family~trt+ctrl,scales="free_y",space="free_y",switch="y")+
    scale_colour_manual(values=ratio_colours)+
    labs(x=mi$name,y=NULL,colour="Ratio",
         title=paste0(branch,": ",mi$name," by sample size, true effect ",eff))+
    theme_report+theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1),text=element_text(size=9))
}
plot_measure("rmse",ref_effect)
```

```{r}
for (eff in levels(metrics$effect)){
  for (meas in measure_info$measure){
    ggsave(paste0(out_dir,file_tag("B",meas,eff),".png"),
           plot_measure(meas,eff),width=16,height=7,dpi=300)
  }
}
```

## Figure C: overview of RMSE relative to the best method

1.00 is the method with the lowest RMSE in that scenario; empty cells are ratios not available for that sample size.

```{r}
plot_heatmap=function(eff){
  scen_levels=metrics %>% distinct(ntrt,nctrl) %>% arrange(ntrt,nctrl) %>% mutate(s=paste0(ntrt,"/",nctrl)) %>% pull(s)
  metrics %>% filter(effect==eff) %>%
    group_by(ntrt,nctrl) %>% mutate(rel=rmse/min(rmse,na.rm=TRUE)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(row=paste0(family,": ",label," (",ratio,")"),
           scen=factor(paste0(ntrt,"/",nctrl),levels=scen_levels)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=scen,y=reorder(row,-rel,mean),fill=rel))+
    geom_tile(colour="white")+
    geom_text(aes(label=sprintf("%.2f",rel)),size=2.6)+
    scale_fill_gradient(low="white",high="#d95f02",name="RMSE /\nbest")+
    labs(x="Treated / controls",y=NULL,
         title=paste0(branch,": RMSE relative to the best method, true effect ",eff))+
    theme_minimal(base_size=9)
}
plot_heatmap(ref_effect)
```

```{r}
for (eff in levels(metrics$effect)){
  ggsave(paste0(out_dir,file_tag("C_heatmap",eff),".png"),plot_heatmap(eff),width=9,height=10,dpi=300)
}
```

## Figure D: rejection rate across effect sizes

Type I error at the null effect, power at the others. Needs results for more than one effect size.

```{r}
plot_rejection=function(nt,nc){
  null_effect=ifelse(scale=="ratio",1,0)
  metrics %>% filter(ntrt==nt,nctrl==nc) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=reject,y=label,colour=ratio))+
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept=ifelse(truth==null_effect,0.05,NA_real_)),linetype=2,colour="grey50",na.rm=TRUE)+
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin=reject-1.96*mcse_reject,xmax=reject+1.96*mcse_reject),height=0,position=pd)+
    geom_point(position=pd,size=1.8)+
    facet_grid(family~effect,scales="free_y",space="free_y",switch="y",
               labeller=labeller(effect=function(x) paste("true effect",x)))+
    scale_colour_manual(values=ratio_colours)+
    labs(x="Rejection rate (type I error at the null, power otherwise)",y=NULL,colour="Ratio",
         title=paste0(branch,": rejection rate, ",scenario_label(nt,nc)))+
    theme_report
}
if (nlevels(metrics$effect)>1) plot_rejection(ref_ntrt,ref_nctrl)
```

```{r}
if (nlevels(metrics$effect)>1){
  scen=metrics %>% distinct(ntrt,nctrl)

           plot_rejection(scen$ntrt[i],scen$nctrl[i]),width=12,height=7,dpi=300)
  }
}
```

## Figure E: covariate balance

Mean absolute SMD before and after matching or weighting (regression methods without weights have no "after").

```{r}
plot_balance=function(eff,nt,nc){
  metrics %>% filter(effect==eff,ntrt==nt,nctrl==nc) %>%
    select(family,label,ratio,smd_age_before,smd_age_after,smd_sex_before,smd_sex_after) %>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with("smd"),names_to=c("covariate","timing"),names_pattern="smd_(age|sex)_(before|after)",values_to="smd") %>%
    filter(!is.na(smd)) %>%
    mutate(covariate=ifelse(covariate=="age","Age of onset","Sex"),
           timing=factor(timing,levels=c("before","after"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=smd,y=label,colour=ratio,shape=timing))+
    geom_vline(xintercept=0.1,linetype=2,colour="grey50")+
    geom_point(position=pd,size=1.8)+
    facet_grid(family~covariate,scales="free_y",space="free_y",switch="y")+
    scale_colour_manual(values=ratio_colours)+
    scale_shape_manual(values=c(before=1,after=16))+
    labs(x="Mean absolute SMD",y=NULL,colour="Ratio",shape=NULL,
         title=paste0(branch,": covariate balance, ",scenario_label(nt,nc)))+
    theme_report
}
plot_balance(ref_effect,ref_ntrt,ref_nctrl)
```

## Figure G: bias against precision

Each point is a method and ratio; dashed circles are lines of equal RMSE (bias² + empirical SE² = RMSE²). Methods to the lower left are both precise and unbiased; methods far from the horizontal line buy precision with bias, or the reverse.

```{r}
plot_tradeoff=function(eff,nt,nc){
  d=metrics %>% filter(effect==eff,ntrt==nt,nctrl==nc)
  r_lev=pretty(range(d$rmse,na.rm=TRUE),n=4); r_lev=r_lev[r_lev>0]
  circles=bind_rows(lapply(r_lev,function(r){
    a=seq(-pi/2,pi/2,length.out=200); tibble(rmse=r,x=r*cos(a),y=r*sin(a))}))
  ggplot(d,aes(x=empse,y=bias))+
    geom_path(data=circles,aes(x=x,y=y,group=rmse),linetype=3,colour="grey60")+
    geom_hline(yintercept=0,linetype=2,colour="grey50")+
    geom_point(aes(colour=family,shape=ratio),size=2.5)+
    coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,max(d$empse,na.rm=TRUE)*1.1),
                    ylim=range(c(d$bias,0),na.rm=TRUE)*1.1)+
    scale_shape_manual(values=c("1:1"=16,"1:2"=17,"1:3"=15,"none"=4))+
    labs(x=paste0("Empirical SE",scale_lab),y=paste0("Bias",scale_lab),colour="Method",shape="Ratio",
         title=paste0(branch,": bias against precision, ",scenario_label(nt,nc),", true effect ",eff),
         subtitle=paste0("Dotted circles: equal RMSE (",paste(r_lev,collapse=", "),")"))+
    theme_bw(base_size=10)+theme(legend.position="right")
}
plot_tradeoff(ref_effect,ref_ntrt,ref_nctrl)
```

## Figure H: treated kept against RMSE

The price of discarding treated patients (calipers, infeasible optimal matches): methods to the left keep fewer of the treated.

```{r}
plot_kept=function(eff,nt,nc){
  metrics %>% filter(effect==eff,ntrt==nt,nctrl==nc,!is.na(kept)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=kept,y=rmse,colour=family,shape=ratio))+
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=rmse-1.96*mcse_rmse,ymax=rmse+1.96*mcse_rmse),width=0,alpha=0.5)+
    geom_point(size=2.5)+
    scale_shape_manual(values=c("1:1"=16,"1:2"=17,"1:3"=15,"none"=4))+
    labs(x="Treated kept",y=paste0("RMSE",scale_lab),colour="Method",shape="Ratio",
         title=paste0(branch,": treated kept against RMSE, ",scenario_label(nt,nc),", true effect ",eff))+
    theme_bw(base_size=10)
}
plot_kept(ref_effect,ref_ntrt,ref_nctrl)
```

# Failures, partial matches and fallbacks

-   **failed**: no estimate (e.g. infeasible optimal matching, empty matched set)
-   **partial**: an estimate, but not all treated were kept (caliper, sex group dropped, no eligible control)
-   **ridge**: survival only, share of estimates from the ridge-penalised Cox model (no convergence, usually no events among the treated)
-   **warnings**: an estimate with a warning from the model (e.g. convergence of the mixed model)

```{r}
problems=metrics %>%
  group_by(effect,family,label,ratio) %>%
  summarise(failed=mean(fail),partial=mean(partial),ridge=mean(ridge),warnings=mean(warn),
            treated_kept=mean(kept),events_treated=mean(events_trt),zero_events_treated=mean(zero_events_trt),
            .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),~round(ifelse(is.nan(.x),NA,.x),3)))
problems %>% filter(effect==ref_effect)
write_csv(problems,paste0(out_dir,"problems_",gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+","_",branch),".csv"))
```

```{r}
# methods and scenarios with any failure, partial match, fallback or warning
metrics %>% filter(fail>0 | coalesce(partial,0)>0 | coalesce(ridge,0)>0 | warn>0) %>%
  select(effect,method,ratio,ntrt,nctrl,n_sim,fail,partial,ridge,warn,kept) %>%
  arrange(desc(fail),desc(ridge))
```

# Comparison of branches

Needs the `performance_*.csv` of at least two branches in `compare_files` (run this file once per branch first). Bias and RMSE of the same methods side by side, for the reference scenario.

```{r}
if (length(compare_files)>1){
  comp_raw=bind_rows(lapply(names(compare_files),function(b){
    read_csv(compare_files[[b]],show_col_types=FALSE) %>% mutate(branch=b,effect=as.character(effect))
  }))
  comp=comp_raw %>%
    filter(effect==ref_effect,ntrt==ref_ntrt,nctrl==ref_nctrl) %>%
    left_join(describe(unique(comp_raw$method)),by="method") %>%
    mutate(family=factor(family,levels=intersect(family_levels,family)),
           label=factor(label,levels=rev(intersect(label_levels,label))),
           ratio=factor(ratio,levels=c("1:1","1:2","1:3","none")),
           branch=factor(branch,levels=names(compare_files))) %>%
    select(branch,family,label,ratio,bias,mcse_bias,rmse,mcse_rmse) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(bias,rmse),names_to="measure",values_to="est") %>%
    mutate(mc=ifelse(measure=="bias",mcse_bias,mcse_rmse),
           measure=ifelse(measure=="bias",paste0("Bias",scale_lab),paste0("RMSE",scale_lab)))
  g_comp=ggplot(comp,aes(x=est,y=label,colour=ratio))+
    geom_vline(data=tibble(measure=paste0("Bias",scale_lab),x=0),aes(xintercept=x),linetype=2,colour="grey50")+
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin=est-1.96*mc,xmax=est+1.96*mc),height=0,position=pd)+
    geom_point(position=pd,size=1.8)+
    facet_grid(family~measure+branch,scales="free",space="free_y",switch="y")+
    scale_colour_manual(values=ratio_colours)+
    labs(x=NULL,y=NULL,colour="Ratio",
         title=paste0("Comparison of branches: ",scenario_label(ref_ntrt,ref_nctrl),", true effect ",ref_effect))+
    theme_report
  print(g_comp)
  ggsave(paste0(out_dir,"I_comparison_",gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9.]+","_",paste(names(compare_files),collapse="_vs_")),".png"),
         g_comp,width=14,height=7,dpi=300)
}
```
